title: Minimum Number of Steps to Make Two Strings Anagram II
goal: Append the fewest characters to make two strings anagrams.
strategy: For each letter, the deficient string needs exactly the difference between the two counts. Summing absolute frequency differences counts all necessary appends on both sides.
